content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ITPO Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online through the portal https://jobapply.in/itpo2026. Upload scanned passport size color photograph and signature. Upload self-attested copies of proof of birth, educational qualifications, caste/category certificates. Upload mark sheets and scorecards of relevant qualifying examinations like SSC or GATE. Candidates working in Central/State Government or Autonomous Organizations must upload No Objection Certificate (NOC). Apply on or before 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ITPO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 13 November 2026. Applications opened on 17 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ITPO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 46 vacancies: 7 Senior Assistant (Civil), 4 Senior Assistant (Electrical), 1 Senior Assistant (Architecture), 10 Assistant (Accounts), 5 Junior Stenographer, 19 Junior Assistant (General Cadre).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ITPO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General/Others: Rs. 1000. SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Serviceman: Exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Senior Assistant (Civil): maximum 28 years; Senior Assistant (Electrical): maximum 28 years; Senior Assistant (Architecture): maximum 28 years; Assistant (Accounts): maximum 28 years; Junior Stenographer: maximum 27 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.29000-110000 (IDA Pattern) for Senior Assistant (Civil), Rs.29000-110000 (IDA Pattern) for Senior Assistant (Electrical), Rs.29000-110000 (IDA Pattern) for Senior Assistant (Architecture), Rs.27500-99000 (IDA Pattern) for Assistant (Accounts), Rs.27500-99000 (IDA Pattern) for Junior Stenographer.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree or Diploma in relevant engineering discipline, B.Com, Bachelor's Degree with shorthand/typing or computer office applications. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates will be liable to be posted anywhere in India. OBC candidates must produce OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate as per Government of India guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates not fulfilling eligibility criteria. Those providing false information.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit list prepared based on final marks and rank secured in respective SSC examinations or GATE scores. Fulfillment of requisite eligibility criteria and experience prescribed in RRs. Document verification. Merit list based on SSC exam ranks or GATE scores and experience verification.
